name: Sports Underdog
definition: An underestimated athlete or team prepares for meaningful competition, turning technical improvement and collective identity into a test of what achievement should mean.
negative_signals: effort guaranteeing victory without skilled opposition
diagnostic_questions: Does training change both capability and relationships?
Can the final contest resolve the story even without literal victory?

neighbors.distinction: Sports underdog organizes growth through preparation and competitive performance.
Competition uses bounded rules and shared recognition rather than armed strategic conflict.

reader_promises.name: Earned improvement
reader_promises.description: Show practice, adjustment, and teamwork producing specific capabilities rather than montage magic.

reader_promises.name: Meaningful contest
reader_promises.description: Make final performance test the story's developed technical, relational, and ethical questions.

roles.name: Underdog competitor
roles.description: Has a genuine deficit and an overlooked resource or capacity for change.

roles.name: Coach or organizer
roles.description: Designs learning while confronting limits in method, authority, or past failure.

roles.name: Credible rival
roles.description: Sets the performance standard and adapts rather than existing as arrogance alone.

movements.name: Deficit exposed
movements.description: Demonstrate why current skill, cohesion, or access is insufficient.

movements.name: Adaptive training
movements.description: Build capability through targeted practice, failure, and role clarification.

movements.name: Qualifying test
movements.description: Prove partial growth while revealing what remains unresolved.

movements.name: Final performance
movements.description: Resolve developed skills and values through choices under competitive pressure.

complications.name: Injury or limit
complications.description: Capability changes and requires redistributed roles rather than miraculous recovery.

complications.name: Team fracture
complications.description: Recognition, fear, or unequal sacrifice disrupts coordination.

complications.name: Institutional barrier
complications.description: Funding, selection, prejudice, or access creates a contest outside the field.

twists.name: Rival's respect
twists.description: The rival recognizes growth and forces a higher, fairer level of competition.

twists.name: Goal redefined
twists.description: The team learns that qualification, survival, or integrity matters more than the advertised title.

conclusions.name: Earned win
conclusions.description: Specific trained capabilities and cooperation produce victory.

conclusions.name: Transforming loss
conclusions.description: The team loses the contest but secures belonging, access, or a durable future.

conclusions.name: Next level
conclusions.description: Performance earns a new challenge while preserving the completed emotional arc.

subversions: Let strategic restraint beat inspirational overexertion.
Give the rival a valid standard and meaningful arc.
cliches_to_avoid: A speech replacing training and tactical change
An unbeatable rival becoming careless only in the finale
quality_checks: Improvement is visible in specific repeated actions.
The rival remains capable and adaptive.
The final result resolves the story's chosen definition of success.

sources.title: The Team Film Genre
sources.contribution: Analyzes differentiated teams, training, preliminary contests, main events, and group codas.

sources.title: Aphorisms for Writing Science Fiction
sources.author_or_organization: Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association
sources.contribution: Supports character-driven action, thematic climax, maintained scale, and dramatic payoff.
